name: Rize
title: rize.io
shortDescription: Rize is an advanced AI-driven time tracking tool designed to enhance productivity for individuals and teams. It automates the tracking of time spent on projects, clients, and tasks, reducing the need for manual input. Ideal for freelancers, managers, and researchers, Rize helps users focus, manage distractions, and optimize time management through features like app blocking and focus music. An example use case is a freelancer using Rize to track time across various projects, ensuring accurate billing and efficient work habits.
pros: Features for focus and distraction management
cons: Limited data retention in free version
Annual billing required for lower monthly rates
